evolutions.rationale: The session shows a repeatable robot-dog inspection loop (move → wait_arrived → capture) with a structured readable/reason feedback field that drives vantage escalation (too small → closer; glare → oblique-front), plus a strict evidence rule that only readable=true captures justify a DONE report. Existing skills cover adjacent pieces (printer-screen-vantage-scan, screen-read-glare-recovery) but none encode the end-to-end escalation ladder, the arrival-gating, or the DONE/evidence contract, and the session's failure mode (claiming a readable capture that was never logged) is exactly what a skill can prevent.
